name: Curve factory ETH pool Vyper lock reentrancy (pETH, alETH)
summary: Vyper 0.2.15 gave each function's @nonreentrant('lock') its own storage slot, so the factory ETH plain-pool template had no shared lock. From the raw-ETH callback in remove_liquidity() the attacker re-entered add_liquidity() before LP supply was reduced, minting LP at an inflated rate and withdrawing it.
notes: pETH/ETH, msETH/ETH and alETH/ETH are EIP-1167 clones of the same factory implementation, so the alETH drain the same afternoon is a copycat of this incident (rule 4). The msETH drain was c0ffeebabe.eth front-running an attacker and returning the proceeds to Metronome, an affiliated rescue, and is excluded. CRV/ETH is separately compiled code and stays its own incident.
Loss is the gross ETH both pools lost plus the alETH the alETH pool lost, not the attackers' net proceeds after repaying their flash loans.
